title: FlexUI Revived
description: Themes for Foundry v13's interface: textured sidebar and controls, glowing tab icons, parchment chat, display fonts and optional slow ambient motion. Ten themes, from the four FlexUI originals (Fantasy, Sci-Fi, Stone, Classic FantasyUI) to Gothic Horror, Cosmic Horror, Neon Noir, Infernal, Frostbound and Faerie Wood. Every icon, texture and font is bundled under a free license. Live switching, a GM table default with per-player choice, per-area toggles, and styles that always yield to other modules. Began as a rewrite of FlexUI by iotech.
